## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Oct 6, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Annette Duhon_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "I have abandoned this app. (My issues are still detailed in the review edit history.) I wouldn't have spent so much time on this review if hadn't spent so much dang money on this Galaxy Watch 8, which I REALLY regret. I'm not even mad anymore. I now use Google Health as far as Health Connect will sync to it, and I use Medisafe for tracking my medications."
            2. _andrew morrow_, Oct 3, 2026, 1/5: "Samsung health step count doesn't work on their new flagship watch, the ultra 2. It'll only track for so long and if the watch reboots or updates the software then the step count freezes and won't accurately count your steps without your phone at hand. Samsung have responded by telling me to reset the watch everytime....... This is the third time since August!"
            3. _Daniel Baumbart_, Sep 27, 2026, 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
